title: TAIEX Closes Below 46,000 as Tech Stocks Slide on AI Slowdown Calls, Middle East Tensions
detail: Taiwan's benchmark TAIEX index dropped 322.33 points (0.7%) to close at 45,862.52 on September 14, 2026, with trading volume falling to NT$630.9 billion from NT$721.9 billion the prior session. The decline was attributed to renewed calls from leading AI executives to slow development pace alongside ongoing Middle East tensions, which together pressured technology stocks. Major chip names were mixed: TSMC fell 1.24% to NT$2,380 and MediaTek slipped 0.55% to NT$4,560, while Foxconn gained 0.2% to NT$248.50. Optical component makers were hit hardest — Largan Precision and Genius Electronic Optical both hit daily limit-down after Morgan Stanley and UBS downgrades — while cybersecurity and power-infrastructure stocks rallied on Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's endorsement of cybersecurity as critical to AI buildout.

title: Taiwan Detects 4 PLA Aircraft Sorties, 2 Crossing into Southwestern/Eastern ADIZ
detail: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense detected 4 PLA aircraft sorties, 6 PLAN vessels and 2 official ships operating around Taiwan in the 24 hours to 6 a.m. (UTC+8) September 14, 2026; 2 of the 4 sorties crossed the Taiwan Strait median line, entering the southwestern and eastern ADIZ sectors. Taiwan's armed forces responded with CAP aircraft, navy ships and coastal missile systems, continuing the low-level daily gray-zone pattern that has held since the Sept 7-8 surge eased.
